en.title: Flap Boost
en.subtitle: Schedule BNB buybacks, then burn, retain, or use each purchase to add holders.
en.subtitleMulti: Create independent BNB buyback tasks. Each task has its own budget, schedule, and controls.
en.states.connect: Connect a wallet to configure this project plan.
en.states.vaultUnavailable: This local preview is not connected to a deployed Flap Boost Vault yet. Deploy and bind the Vault before sending a transaction.
en.states.createVault: You do not have a Flap Boost Vault yet. Create one for this connected wallet; switching back to this wallet will load the same Vault automatically.
en.states.createMultiVault: Create your new multi-task Flap Boost Vault. It can run several independent buyback tasks at the same time.
en.states.factoryRequired: The shared Flap Boost Factory is not deployed or bound to this Mini App yet. After it is bound, this button creates a Vault owned by the connected wallet.
en.states.factoryUnavailable: The Flap Boost Factory cannot be reached on this network. Switch to BSC Testnet and try again.
en.states.ownerOnly: Only the plan owner can change settings or withdraw funds.
en.states.actionsUnavailable: Actions wait for Flap market data to become available.
en.states.wrongNetwork: Switch to {chain} before sending a transaction.
en.states.noPlan: Set the target, buy rule, schedule, and result; then activate this plan. BNB can be funded before or after activation.
en.states.legacyTask: This older Vault does not support closing task records yet. Create a Vault from the updated Factory to use task closing.
en.states.pauseFirst: Pause the plan and wait for scheduled work to settle before changing settings or withdrawing BNB.
en.states.pendingDistribution: A holder-distribution batch is still running automatically.
en.states.noExecutions: The first execution record appears after the scheduled Trigger finishes.
en.states.selectTokenFirst: Select the buyback token CA above first.
en.states.noBuyWhilePaused: No buy will happen while paused
en.states.pausedTriggerPending: Automation is paused. The pending Trigger will only clear this task; it will not buy tokens.
en.states.pausedStopped: Automation is paused. Resume when you want to queue the next buyback.
en.states.budgetRequired: No buyback is queued. Add enough BNB for a full round to continue.
en.help.fixedBnb: Uses exactly this BNB amount every round. If the budget is short, the plan stops and waits for a top-up.
en.help.balanceRatio: Uses this percentage of spendable BNB on every round.
en.help.fixedToken: Uses Flap Portal's live quote to find BNB for this token target, with your slippage limit applied.
en.help.targetToken: Enter the token CA that BNB should buy. This does not transfer or require you to hold this token.
en.help.budget: The BNB budget pays both buybacks and Flap Trigger automation fees.
en.help.funding: BNB may be added at any time and is the only funding required for a buyback.
en.help.budgetFlow: This is the plan's spendable budget. Add BNB whenever you want more rounds; it also pays the Trigger fee for each scheduled round.
en.help.assets: BNB is the only asset a buyback spends. Token storage is optional and remains separately withdrawable after the current task is closed.
en.help.loadCa: Enter a token CA, then load it to view the wallet and Vault balances before adding or withdrawing tokens.
en.help.tokenAssets: Optional reserve only: a fixed-BNB buyback does not need you to deposit this token. The first add authorizes the Vault; click again to transfer it.
en.help.tokenAssetsActive: While a task is running, this CA must match its buyback target. Close the task before withdrawing token reserves from the updated Vault.
en.help.closeTask: Close removes this task from the active workspace immediately. Its on-chain task and execution records remain available below.
en.help.taskRecords: These are task-level records. They are separate from individual buyback executions and cannot be deleted from the chain.
en.help.taskTable: Each row is an independent schedule. All active tasks spend directly from the single Vault BNB balance.
en.help.results: Results are calculated separately for each buyback-token CA, so different tokens are never combined.
en.help.bnbFunds: Deposit BNB once to the Vault. Every task spends directly from this shared balance; eligible waiting tasks are scheduled again as soon as funds arrive.
en.help.unallocatedWithdraw: Withdraw any BNB currently available in the Vault. Already paid Trigger fees and completed buybacks are excluded.
en.help.taskBudget: BNB is added from the task row after this task is created. It pays this task's buybacks and Trigger fees.
en.help.noTaskFunding: First select the buyback token CA above, then create your first task. The task will use the Vault's shared BNB balance.
en.help.tokenAssetsMulti: Token storage is optional and does not fund BNB buybacks. Load any token CA to inspect, deposit, or withdraw it; token withdrawal waits for holder distributions to settle.
en.help.start: BNB has already been funded above. Activation only saves the buyback settings.
en.help.fundBeforeStart: Fund BNB before starting a plan. You can withdraw it before setup, or keep adding BNB after startup.
en.help.fundAfterStart: Fund BNB before starting, or add it here after startup.
en.help.tokenFunding: Add {token} to this Vault after activation. The first click authorizes the Vault; click again to transfer. You can withdraw only when the plan is paused and all work has settled.
en.help.tokenFundingBeforeStart: Load the token CA in the plan form, then add or withdraw that token before activation. Activation requires the same CA as any remaining token reserve.
en.help.random: The vault derives recipient addresses and processes them in small automatic batches; no batch size needs to be configured.
en.help.fixed: Enter one address per line, up to five distinct holder addresses.
en.notices.riskMissing: The host did not provide a contract risk status. Review the deployed Vault before funding it.
en.notices.market: This plan uses Flap Portal, so it supports both internal-market and DEX-listed phases.
en.notices.network: Your connected wallet is on the wrong network.
en.errors.targetToken: Enter a valid target-token contract address.
en.errors.targetLookup: This CA could not be read as a token through the Vault.
en.errors.loadTokenFirst: Load a valid token CA before moving token assets.
en.errors.tokenMatchesTask: While a task is active, the reserve CA must match that task's buyback target.
en.errors.interval: The interval must be at least one minute.
en.errors.planAlreadyStarted: This plan is already active. Refresh to view the scheduled task.
en.errors.slippage: Enter a slippage value from 0% to 50%.
en.errors.fixedRecipients: Enter one to five distinct valid addresses.
en.errors.randomHolders: Enter a random-holder count from 1 to 200.
en.errors.funding: Enter a valid BNB funding amount.
en.errors.unallocatedBnb: This amount is greater than the Vault's unallocated BNB.
en.errors.tokenFunding: Enter a valid positive token amount.
en.errors.tokenBalance: Your wallet does not hold enough of this token.
en.errors.tokenWithdraw: Enter a valid token amount that is available in the Vault.
en.errors.simulation: Pre-transaction check failed. Verify the BNB budget, token CA, and plan settings.
en.errors.tx: Transaction failed. Check the wallet prompt and on-chain plan state, then try again.
en.messages.tokenApproved: Token authorization is complete. Click again to transfer tokens into the Vault.
en.messages.tokensFunded: Token reserve added to the Vault.
en.messages.taskClosed: Task closed. Its record remains in task history.
en.messages.vaultCreated: Your Flap Boost Vault is ready.
en.messages.tasksChecked: Vault balance checked; eligible tasks have been scheduled.

zh.title: Flap Boost
zh.subtitle: 定时用 BNB 回购，再销毁、留存，或把每轮买到的代币用于增加持有人。
zh.subtitleMulti: 创建多个独立回购任务；每个任务都有自己的 BNB 预算、执行时间和操作按钮。
zh.distribution.fixed: 固定地址 · 最多 5 个
zh.placeholders.targetToken: 输入 0x 代币合约地址
zh.placeholders.fixedRecipients: 每行输入一个 0x 地址
zh.states.connect: 请连接钱包后再设置项目计划。
zh.states.vaultUnavailable: 当前本地预览尚未连接到已部署的 Flap Boost Vault。部署并绑定 Vault 后才能发送交易。
zh.states.createVault: 当前连接的钱包还没有 Flap Boost Vault。创建后，切回这个钱包会自动加载同一个 Vault。
zh.states.createMultiVault: 创建新版多任务 Flap Boost Vault。它可以同时运行多个相互独立的回购任务。
zh.states.factoryRequired: 共享 Flap Boost Factory 还没有部署或绑定到这个 Mini App。绑定后，这个按钮会为当前连接的钱包创建专属 Vault。
zh.states.factoryUnavailable: 当前网络无法访问 Flap Boost Factory。请切换到 BSC Testnet 后重试。
zh.states.ownerOnly: 只有计划所有者可以修改设置或提取资金。
zh.states.actionsUnavailable: 等待 Flap 市场数据可用后才能操作。
zh.states.wrongNetwork: 请先切换到 {chain} 再发送交易。
zh.states.noPlan: 先设置回购目标、金额、时间和买入后处理方式，再启动计划；BNB 可以在启动前或启动后补充。
zh.states.legacyTask: 当前是旧版 Vault，尚不支持关闭任务记录。需使用更新后的 Factory 创建 Vault，才能关闭任务。
zh.states.pauseFirst: 修改设置或提取 BNB 前，请先暂停计划并等待已排期工作结算。
zh.states.pendingDistribution: 增加持有人的分发批次仍在自动执行。
zh.states.noExecutions: 首轮 Trigger 执行完成后，会在这里显示回购记录。
zh.states.selectTokenFirst: 请先在上方选择回购代币 CA。
zh.states.pausedTriggerPending: 自动执行已暂停。当前 Trigger 只会清理这条任务，不会买入代币。
zh.states.pausedStopped: 自动执行已暂停；恢复后才会排入下一次回购。
zh.states.budgetRequired: 当前没有已排期的回购。补足一整轮 BNB 后会继续执行。
zh.help.fixedBnb: 每轮严格使用这笔 BNB；预算不足一整轮时会停止并等待补充，不会偷偷使用剩余 BNB。
zh.help.balanceRatio: 每轮使用可花费 BNB 的这个比例。
zh.help.fixedToken: 执行时使用 Flap Portal 实时报价反推达到该代币目标所需的 BNB，并按设置的滑点保护成交。
zh.help.targetToken: 输入要用 BNB 买入的代币 CA；这里只是指定回购目标，不需要把该代币转入 Vault，也不要求钱包持有它。
zh.help.budget: BNB 预算同时用于回购本金和 Flap Trigger 自动执行手续费。
zh.help.funding: 回购只需要 BNB，且可随时补充或提取未使用部分。
zh.help.budgetFlow: 这是计划可花费的预算。想增加回购轮次时补充 BNB；每次排期还会支付 Trigger 自动执行手续费。
zh.help.assets: 回购实际只花 BNB。代币储备是可选资产，关闭当前任务后可单独提取，不再和计划混在一起。
zh.help.loadCa: 输入代币 CA 后加载，即可先查看钱包和 Vault 的余额，再补充或提取代币。
zh.help.tokenAssets: 这是可选储备：固定 BNB 回购不需要先存入代币。首次补充是授权 Vault，第二次点击才会转入代币。
zh.help.tokenAssetsActive: 任务运行时，补充的 CA 必须与该任务回购目标一致。使用新版 Vault 需先关闭任务才能提取代币储备。
zh.help.closeTask: 关闭后任务会立刻从当前工作区移除；链上的任务记录和执行记录仍会保留在下方。
zh.help.taskRecords: 这里是任务级记录，与每轮真实成交的执行记录分开；链上记录不能删除。
zh.help.taskTable: 每一行都是独立的执行计划。所有运行中的任务直接使用同一个 Vault BNB 余额。
zh.help.results: 按每个回购代币 CA 单独统计，多个代币不会再叠加到一起。
zh.help.bnbFunds: BNB 只需充值一次到 Vault。所有任务直接使用这笔共享余额；余额到账后，满足条件的等待任务会自动重新排期。
zh.help.unallocatedWithdraw: 这里可以提取 Vault 当前可用的 BNB；已支付的 Trigger 手续费和已完成的回购不会重复提取。
zh.help.taskBudget: 任务创建后，在任务行里补充 BNB；这笔 BNB 用于该任务的回购本金和 Trigger 自动执行手续费。
zh.help.noTaskFunding: 请先在上方选择回购代币 CA，再创建第一条任务。任务会直接使用 Vault 的共享 BNB 余额。
zh.help.tokenAssetsMulti: 代币储备是可选资产，不用于支付 BNB 回购。加载任意代币 CA 后即可查看、补充或提取；有持有人分发进行中时暂不能提取。
zh.help.start: BNB 已在上方充值；启动计划只保存回购设置。
zh.help.fundBeforeStart: 可以先充值 BNB，再启动计划；未启动时也可提取，启动后仍可随时继续补充。
zh.help.fundAfterStart: 可先充值 BNB，也可以启动后继续补充。
zh.help.tokenFunding: 启动计划后可把 {token} 补充到此 Vault。首次点击只会授权 Vault，再点一次才会转入。仅在计划暂停且全部执行完成后可以提取。
zh.help.tokenFundingBeforeStart: 先在计划表单加载代币 CA，即可在启动前补充或提取该代币。若储备中仍有代币，启动计划时必须使用同一个 CA。
zh.help.random: 合约生成接收地址并自动分成小批处理，不需要设置每批数量。
zh.help.fixed: 每行输入一个地址，最多 5 个且不能重复。
zh.notices.riskMissing: 宿主没有提供合约风险状态。请在充值前检查已部署的 Vault。
zh.notices.market: 计划使用 Flap Portal，因此内盘和 DEX 阶段都支持。
zh.notices.network: 当前连接的钱包不在正确网络。
zh.errors.amount: 请输入有效的正数数量。
zh.errors.targetToken: 请输入有效的目标代币合约地址。
zh.errors.targetLookup: 无法通过 Vault 将该 CA 读取为代币。
zh.errors.loadTokenFirst: 请先加载有效的代币 CA，再操作代币资产。
zh.errors.tokenMatchesTask: 任务运行时，储备代币 CA 必须与该任务的回购目标一致。
zh.errors.interval: 执行间隔至少为 1 分钟。
zh.errors.planAlreadyStarted: 计划已经启动，请刷新后查看当前任务。
zh.errors.slippage: 滑点必须在 0% 到 50% 之间。
zh.errors.retainWallet: 请输入有效的留存钱包地址。
zh.errors.fixedRecipients: 请输入 1 到 5 个互不重复的有效地址。
zh.errors.randomHolders: 随机持有人数量必须在 1 到 200 之间。
zh.errors.funding: 请输入有效的 BNB 充值数量。
zh.errors.unallocatedBnb: 该数量超过 Vault 当前未分配的 BNB。
zh.errors.tokenFunding: 请输入有效的正数代币数量。
zh.errors.tokenBalance: 当前钱包中的该代币余额不足。
zh.errors.tokenWithdraw: 请输入 Vault 中可用的有效代币提取数量。
zh.errors.withdraw: 请输入有效的未使用 BNB 数量。
zh.errors.simulation: 交易预检查失败。请检查 BNB 预算、回购代币 CA 和计划参数。
zh.errors.tx: 交易失败。请检查钱包确认和链上计划状态后重试。
zh.messages.tokenApproved: 代币授权已完成，请再次点击把代币转入 Vault。
zh.messages.tokensFunded: 代币储备已补充到 Vault。
zh.messages.taskClosed: 任务已关闭，记录会保留在任务历史中。
zh.messages.taskCreated: 回购任务已创建并进入排期。
zh.messages.withdrawn: 未使用 BNB 已提取。
zh.messages.vaultCreated: 你的 Flap Boost Vault 已创建完成。
zh.messages.tasksChecked: 已检查 Vault 余额，满足条件的任务已重新排期。
